notes.subject: צבי
notes.rationale: Strong's gloss 'splendor' — tradisone こちら ol i tanim olsem 'dia'/'gazelle' (metathesis bilong צביה); mi bihainim 'dia'.

notes.subject: יקוש
notes.rationale: 'Yangka/man i wokim yangka' — tok i tok botong entangled/snare; sambaodi i tanim olsem 'fowler' (man bilong karamapim pisin).

notes.subject: botong man i gat belts long paitim nem bilong ol man
notes.rationale: Komand — 'Salim yu yet' — em i kolim leta man bilong brukim kontrak (6:1-3).

translation: Salim yu yet olsem dia long han, na olsem pisin long han bilong man i wokim yangka.
